time_basis: UTC; SteamVR text timestamps are in local time, one hour ahead.

first_run.amf_evidence: AMF active (native HostAMF stats). 452 pool-full raw-frame drops by 01:40:37, 1068 by 01:41:23; zero reported AMF failures. Output age per-second maxima usually 67–69ms in retained bad window.
first_run.qualification: Partial retained incident windows, not representative whole-session averages. Frame age and ALVR latency fields are not motion-to-photon measurements.

late_transport_interruption.finding: Bilateral media/control interruption while client tracking and host encoding continued. Compatible with link interruption; report cannot identify Wi-Fi driver, AP or other network cause.

startup_finding: Both local compositor launches selected the same physical 120.019Hz mode. No evidence that another fixed startup delay or refresh-rate renegotiation fixes the first run. First-run root cause remains unresolved; local power/clock/resource observations were missing.
confirmed_cleanup: Native host chaperone used full width/depth for each perimeter half-extent. Corrected to ±half dimensions.
Native and host helper now inspect live bounds, wall geometry and remote identity origins before deciding a commit is needed; reconnect does not repeatedly rewrite unchanged chaperone.
Added off-frame-loop cached read-only Linux GPU/power/frequency evidence, omitted when unsupported.
deferred_amf_candidate: Current full-pool path drains one output then unconditionally drops newest raw image. Rechecking a freed slot could avoid a subset of drops, but QueryOutput can block up to frame+2ms and adding a second drain would alter capture timing. Leave stable encoder implementation unchanged in this RC; design and GPU-test a separately bounded output-drain change later.
ethernet_test: Keep codec, resolution, refresh and bitrate fixed. Select Ethernet adapter explicitly when Wi-Fi remains connected so comparison has a verified path.
